dogecoin.text:
2/ "The Day Starts with a Small Mistake"
One morning, @AgentNyla spotted a "golden signal."
“Mr. Joe, buy DOGECOIN now! 🚀” it declared.
Trusting the bot, Joe bought it.
Minutes later, DOGECOIN plummeted 30%! 😱
Joe: “Golden signal? More like a golden trap!”
